decision_basis: The specialized successor proved exact public Policy-DROID, OSCAR, and Ctrl-World runtime compatibility, but it did not complete a causally qualified closed-loop multi-policy ranking on disjoint physical outcomes. Native Cosmos remained failed for its frozen configuration, OSCAR and Ctrl-World public canaries were open-loop replay, the hybrid was technically blocked, both new complete-graph judge arms were incomplete, Phase B was not measured, and captured-site/economics gates were not admitted.

cosmos_wam_qualification.basis: No successor WAM passed a frozen causal control matrix.

frozen_benchmark_calibration.basis: Neither GPT-5 nor Gemini completed its registered 1,323-pair graph, and partial graphs cannot be aggregated.

captured_site_transfer.basis: Prerequisite WAM, ranking, and abstention gates did not pass; no matched physical site outcomes were available.

economics_and_speed.basis: Digital execution cost was measured without a useful complete ranking or attributable physical baseline.
